news: Agents
Phipal now plans a whole weekend
Ask for a weekend in Bijou and it books the ride, holds a table and buys the entry PFT in one go.
Stories
An agent that saved a club treasury
When floor prices fell, Ines set her Phipal to stake idle SUM. The club ended the month ahead.
Muse
Muse learns your taste in looks
Muse now ranks new drops by the looks you wear most, not by what is trending.
Safety
Spending limits per goal
Every goal now carries a cap. Your agent stops and asks before it goes over.
Agents
Teams of agents share one plan
Scout, buyer and treasurer agents now write to one plan you can read and edit.
Stories
The ferry ticket nobody had to buy
Kofi asked for the cheapest way to Aurum. Phipal found a rental PFT that came with the ride.
Models
Smaller model, same answers
The on device model is now half the size and runs on most laptops without a fan.
Muse
Muse writes your club notes
After an event, Muse drafts the notes and tags the members who were there.
Safety
Sign as you, only where you say
Delegation now lists each app your agent may sign in, and you can revoke one at a time.
Agents
Bids that wait for the right price
Set a floor and a ceiling. The buyer agent watches the pool and bids only inside them.
Stories
A first sale while asleep
Lena listed three PFTs before bed. Her agent matched two offers by morning.
Talk
Voice talk arrives
Talk to Phipal out loud on desktop. Replies come back as text and voice.

faq.q: Can my agent spend without asking?
faq.a: Only inside the cap you set for each goal.
On your machine by default. You can switch to a hosted model in settings.

faq.q: Can I stop a goal halfway?
faq.a: Yes. Every goal has a stop button and a log of what was done.
Only the threads you share with it.

faq.q: Can I run more than one agent?
faq.a: Yes. Each goal can spawn a small team, and you can see all of them in Agents.
